title: Math
intro: The mathematics of change, of strategy and of signals.

items: Calculus (#/math/calculus): A template topic: the mathematics of continuous change, from limits and derivatives to integrals.
Game Theory (#/math/game-theory): A template topic: the study of strategic decision-making among rational agents.
The Z-Transform (#/math/z-transform): The z-transform as a landscape over the complex plane, with a 3D viewer of poles, zeros, the region of convergence and the frequency response.

The Laplace Transform (#/math/laplace-transform): The Laplace transform as a landscape over the s-plane, with a 3D viewer of poles, zeros, the region of convergence and the frequency response, and its use for solving differential equations.
The Fourier Transform (#/math/fourier-transform): Signals built from sinusoids, with a 3D viewer of harmonics and spectra, from Fourier series to sampling, the DFT and the fast Fourier transform.

Convolution (#/math/convolution): Convolution as flip, slide, multiply and add, with a 3D viewer of the whole operation, from impulse responses and discrete sums to the convolution theorem and fast convolution with the FFT.
